The founder

Meet Rafy.

Rafy picked up the clippers in 2004 and has been sharpening his craft ever since. Some clients have trusted him for over seven years, and they’ll tell you why: he listens, he takes his time, and he doesn’t let you leave until it’s right.

When you walk out of his shop, you’re wearing his name. He takes that personally, so you never have to worry about how your cut turns out.

  • Our missionEvery client walks out looking and feeling their best. No rushed cuts, no guesswork, no “it’ll grow out.”
  • Our visionTo be the barbershop Kitchener-Waterloo trusts for life, from a kid’s first haircut to the cut before the big day.
  • Our promiseWe listen first, take our time, and you only pay once you love what you see in the mirror.

FAQ

Got questions? We’ve got answers.

Do you take walk-ins?

Yes, Monday to Saturday. If you’d rather not wait, book online and your chair is ready when you arrive.

How much is a haircut?

$35 for a haircut, $50 with a beard. You pay after your cut, once you’re happy with it.

Do you cut kids' hair?

Absolutely. Kids 12 and under are $25, first haircuts included. We’re patient, so it’s an easy visit for them and for you.

Where are you exactly?

22 King St S, Unit 204, in Uptown Waterloo, steps from Waterloo Public Square.
